title: Crossbows Reloaded - Prominence 2 Balancing Datapack
description: Small datapack that makes some crossbows from MCDW have an 8 enchant limit in Prominence II - Hasturian Era.
body:
This datapack serves an an utility to add a limit of 8 enchantments (instead of the default 6 enchantments) that regular weapons have. It works by adding a specific tag (`#prominent:limit_8`) to the following crossbows from MCDW:
- Corrupted Crossbow
- Lightning Harp Crossbow
- Pride of the Piglins
- Veiled Crossbow

When the tag is applied, those crossbows get a limit of 8 enchants.
